# Base.com

> Base.com to zintegrowany system e-commerce do zarządzania sprzedażą wielokanałową (omnichannel), stworzony do automatyzacji i skalowania biznesu e-commerce. Łączymy kluczowe procesy operacyjne w jednym systemie: zarządzanie zamówieniami (OMS), produktami (PIM) i magazynem (WMS), przesyłkami, księgowością (ERP).

Najlepszy system do zarządzania e-commerce i kropka.

# Strona główna

# Darmowa wersja próbna
- https://base.com/pl-PL/rejestracja/: Załóż konto i zacznij automatyzować sprzedaż przez 14 dni za darmo. Bez zobowiązań i bez karty kredytowej.

# Kluczowe możliwości systemu:
- Centralne zarządzanie zamówieniami ze wszystkich kanałów sprzedaży (OMS)
- Synchronizacja stanów magazynowych w czasie rzeczywistym (WMS)
- Centralna baza danych o produktach (PIM)
- Integracje z systemami księgowymi i ERP
- Masowe zarządzanie ofertami na ponad 300 platformach marketplace
- Tworzenie zaawansowanych reguł automatyzujących procesy
- Automatyczne dostosowywanie cen na marketplace (Repricing)
- Wykorzystanie AI do generowania opisów, tłumaczeń i obsługi klienta

---

# Moduły Systemu

## System zarządzania zamówieniami (OMS)
Tytuł: System zarządzania zamówieniami (OMS)
URL: https://base.com/pl-PL/funkcje/zamowienia/
Podsumowanie: Moduł agreguje zamówienia ze wszystkich kanałów sprzedaży w jednym panelu. Automatyzuje kluczowe procesy, w tym nadawanie paczek, drukowanie etykiet, fakturowanie oraz komunikację z klientem. System minimalizuje też ryzyko pomyłek przy kompletacji dzięki Asystentowi Pakowania.
Tagi: oms, zarządzanie zamówieniami, zarządzanie sprzedażą internetową, automatyzacja zamówień, manager sprzedaży internetowej
Najczęstsze zapytania: ["jak zarządzać zamówieniami z allegro i sklepu w jednym miejscu?", "program do automatycznej obsługi zamówień"]

## System zarządzania magazynem (WMS)
Tytuł: System zarządzania magazynem (WMS)
URL: https://base.com/pl-PL/funkcje/magazyn/
Podsumowanie: Moduł synchronizuje stany magazynowe w czasie rzeczywistym we wszystkich kanałach sprzedaży, eliminując ryzyko sprzedaży niedostępnych produktów. System optymalizuje procesy takie jak przyjęcia towaru, kompletacja zamówień i inwentaryzacja, wykorzystując aplikację mobilną i skanery.
Tagi: wms, system zarządzania magazynem, stany magazynowe, gospodarka magazynowa
Najczęstsze zapytania: ["jak uniknąć sprzedaży produktu, którego nie ma na stanie", "program do optymalizacji pracy magazynu"]

## System zarządzania informacją o produkcie (PIM)
Tytuł: System zarządzania informacją o produkcie (PIM)
URL: https://base.com/pl-PL/funkcje/produkty/
Podsumowanie: Moduł pozwala na centralne zarządzanie wszystkimi danymi produktowymi – opisami, zdjęciami, atrybutami, kodami EAN – w jednym miejscu. Umożliwia masowe operacje na tysiącach produktów i automatyczną synchronizację na wszystkich kanałach sprzedaży.
Tagi: pim, zarządzanie produktami, dane produktowe, product information management, centralizacja danych produktowych
Najczęstsze zapytania: ["jak masowo zarządzać produktami na marketplace", "centralna baza produktów dla e-commerce"]

## Zarządzanie księgowością i rozliczeniami (ERP)
Tytuł: Zarządzanie księgowością i rozliczeniami (ERP)
URL: https://base.com/pl-PL/funkcje/ksiegowosc/
Podsumowanie: Moduł w pełni automatyzuje procesy fakturowania i rozliczeń, eliminując ręczną pracę i ryzyko pomyłek. System masowo generuje wszystkie niezbędne dokumenty sprzedażowe (faktury, e-paragony, korekty), porządkuje je w jednym, przejrzystym rejestrze i zapewnia dwukierunkową synchronizację z popularnymi systemami ERP oraz programami księgowości online.
Tagi: księgowość e-commerce, integracje erp, fakturowanie, automatyzacja księgowości, rozliczenia
Najczęstsze zapytania: ["jak zautomatyzować fakturowanie w sklepie internetowym?", "program do automatyzacji księgowości"]

---

# Ekosystem Base.com

- **Super Merchant**: Kompleksowa usługa obsługi sprzedaży produktów klienta na ponad 50 zagranicznych marketplace'ach. URL: https://supermerchant.base.com/
- **Responso**: Narzędzie do zarządzania komunikacją z klientami z wielu kanałów (m.in. Allegro, Amazon, e-mail) w jednym miejscu. URL: https://responso.com/pl/
- **Base Analytics**: Narzędzie analityczne dostarczające przejrzyste raporty i statystyki dotyczące sprzedaży, pomagające identyfikować najlepiej sprzedające się produkty. URL: https://base.com/pl-PL/funkcje/base-analytics/
- **Base Connect**: Platforma B2B umożliwiająca automatyczną wymianę danych (o produktach, zamówieniach, przesyłkach) pomiędzy różnymi użytkownikami systemu. URL: https://base.com/pl-PL/funkcje/base-connect/
- **Base Store**: Oficjalny sklep z urządzeniami dla e-commerce, takimi jak skanery kodów, drukarki etykiet czy kolektory danych, w pełni kompatybilnymi z systemem. URL: https://base.store/
- **Base Courier**: Platforma logistyczna do nadawania paczek i palet w kraju i za granicą bez konieczności podpisywania umów z kurierami. URL: https://basecourier.com/

 Order Manager 
 
expand
 
collapse
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
All sales channels in one place
 
 
 
 
 
 
Fulfill all your orders in one user-friendly panel, whether they be from a marketplace, online shop, over the phone or in person. Managing your sales has never been this easy!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Fulfill orders faster than ever
 
 
 
 
 
 
Base.com can automate your business processes such as sending messages to customers, changing order statuses, issuing invoices, creating shipments and printing necessary documents.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Impress the customer
 
 
 
 
 
 
The Pick&Pack Assistant ensures you pack every parcel correctly, including sending a photo of the package to the customer. When customers call your business, Base Caller will display their orders on your phone screen.
 
 
 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Product Manager 
 
expand
 
collapse
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
A practical product database
 
 
 
 
 
 
Manage your product selection and store your data in Base. Manage stocks and prices directly from the Base catalog, or catalog offers from outside your online store.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Fast & flexible product import
 
 
 
 
 
 
Add products into the catalog in multiple ways: importing marketplace or online store offers, with a CSV file, or manually.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
List products on marketplaces right from the Base platform
 
 
 
 
 
 
The listing form automatically assigns offer templates, shipping settings, categories, and auto-fills product data. List hundreds of offers with only a few clicks!
 
 
 
 
Learn more

collapse
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Rapid listing from any warehouse
 
 
 
 
 
 
Connect a store, wholesaler, ERP system or use the Base.com warehouse. Take a moment to set up the listing rules to accelerate the process.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Manage online sales from one panel
 
 
 
 
 
 
Whichever marketplace (e.g. Amazon or eBay) you sell on, you can control all offers from one system. Check the offer statuses and edit them in bulk.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
No more stock and price discrepancies!
 
 
 
 
 
 
Base.com ensures automatic stock and price synchronization on multiple marketplace platforms at the same time. It can also close offers for you if the stock or price reaches zero.
 
 
 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Shipping management 
 
expand
 
collapse
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The shipping process focused in one place
 
 
 
 
 
 
We have gathered multiple delivery operators in the system so that you can send shipments from one panel instead of logging in to each carrier's account. You can create shipments one by one, in bulk or set the system to create them automatically!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Keep the customer in touch with the shipment
 
 
 
 
 
 
No longer need to remember about sending notifications - the system will send an automatic message whenever a package status changes. The customer can also check out the status on the order information page.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Enjoy the automation
 
 
 
 
 
 
Base.com will assist you in forwarding the shipping number to the marketplace and store. In addition, it will print out the shipping labels, e.g. when you mark the order as 'packed'.
 
 
 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Workflow automation 
 
expand
 
collapse
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Automatic status changes
 
 
 
 
 
 
Create custom statuses to help you organize your order list. The automatic action module will move orders between them when the specified event occurs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Reduce the order processing time!
 
 
 
 
 
 
Use the Pick&Pack Assistant and automatic actions, to significantly decrease the processing time for each package. The system applies a barcode scanner to minimize the manual workload.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Let yourself free from repetitive activities
 
 
 
 
 
 
Instead of sending messages to customers, issuing invoices, creating shipments or printing labels, focus on expanding your business and your product offer, while the system will perform recurring tasks for you.
 
 
 
 
Learn more

Place wholesale orders in minutes
 
 
 
 
 
 
Select and order products from the catalog visible in Base Connect, reducing the risk of errors. Track progress of your order in real time.

expand
 
collapse
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Quickly adjust prices to the market situation
 
 
 
 
 
 
If prices from other vendors go up or down, the repricing function will automatically adjust your prices for each situation - on your terms.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Save time and resources
 
 
 
 
 
 
Free up your and your team's time. Set rules to change prices and forget about manually updating each listing.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Take care of your pricing and margins
 
 
 
 
 
 
When others' offers become more expensive or run out of stock, the system will automatically raise the prices of your products and protect your margin.

Expand cross-border sales

Homepage
Functions
Product Manager
 
 
Manage Product Information – Sell Everywhere
 
Create, organise, synchronise, and eliminate chaos in your product data. Base is your centre for product information management—automated, scalable, and ready for multi-channel sales.
 
 
Try it for free
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What Do You Gain from Managing Product Information in Base?
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Data Consistency Across the Team
 Say goodbye to errors caused by scattered information. Base PIM is a single, reliable source of product data—accessible to everyone from marketing to logistics. It streamlines work, reduces the risk of mistakes, and builds customer trust.
 
 
 
 
 
Automation of Product Information
 Import products, images, descriptions, prices, and specifications, or leverage AI to create fresh product descriptions. Additionally, streamline category matching, product parameter alignment, and background removal from images.
 
 
 
 
 
Greater Visibility on Marketplaces
 By tailoring content to each sales channel, your products respond better to customer searches and rank higher. That’s more traffic and higher conversions—without increasing your advertising budget.
 
 
 
 
 
Ready for International Expansion
 Integrated translations and Multi EAN support make it easy to adapt your listings to different market requirements. It’s a real opportunity to enter international sales quickly—without language barriers.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Discover the Capabilities of Base PIM
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 One Source of Truth – Complete Data Consistency 
 
 Say goodbye to the chaos of scattered information. With Base, all your product data is in one place. The Product Card Information section is the heart of the Base PIM system, serving as the single, reliable source of up-to-date, complete, and verified product information for everyone in your business. This eliminates the data discrepancies often found in e-commerce businesses using multiple systems. Data consistency not only saves time and reduces errors but also builds trust with your customers and business partners. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Channel-Specific Content 
 
 Maximise the potential of every platform with tailored content. Base lets you create separate versions of descriptions, titles, images, and attributes for each sales channel. Each marketplace has its own customer preferences and search algorithms—Amazon’s A9 and eBay’s Cassini, for example, reward unique, platform-specific content that aligns with user searches. Create content that meets the SEO requirements of each marketplace and increases your product’s visibility. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Efficient Multi-Channel Sales 
 
 With Base PIM, listing products across multiple online shops and marketplaces becomes incredibly simple. Instead of manually entering the same information into different systems, you only need to update the data in one place—and the system automatically synchronises it with all connected sales channels. This saves time and minimises the risk of errors. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Product Tags for Smart Organisation 
 
 With tags, you gain full control over how you organise, filter, and automate product management. They offer unlimited flexibility—create them as needed for marketing campaigns, specific sales channels, or product statuses. Tags can trigger automatic actions or act as conditions for sales rules. The system can automatically update prices for all products tagged as “Spring Promotion” or generate descriptions for a new collection. Tags also make it easy to filter products precisely and list them on the right platforms. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Predefined Parameters to Eliminate Chaos 
 
 The predefined parameter system puts an end to messy tables, inconsistencies, and errors when listing products. Instead of randomly defined attributes, you get a standardised structure where each parameter has a specific format and group. This means quick filtering, easy editing, and full compliance with marketplace requirements. Your data is consistent, organised, and ready for bulk use. It simplifies managing even the largest catalogues—you can quickly update information, identify gaps and duplicates, or group products. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Bulk Operations – Thousands of Changes with One Click 
 
 Bulk operations are the foundation of efficient management for large product catalogues. Base lets you edit, delete, categorise, change prices, translate, or generate descriptions for thousands of SKUs at once. Create your own operation templates and run them automatically—daily, weekly, or when specific conditions are met. Saved templates can be reused as often as needed, ensuring consistency. It’s a reliable support system for your team. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Relationships: Supporting Cross-Selling and Up-Selling 
 
 Build smart connections in your catalogue. The Relationships section lets you link products into bundles, show alternatives, display compatible parts, or highlight items from the same collection. It’s a great tool for increasing basket value and improving the customer shopping experience. By showing related products, you make purchase decisions easier and boost complementary sales. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Automatic SKU and Multi EAN Generation 
 
 Base automatically generates unique SKUs based on your rules—including categories, variants, brands, and other parameters. The Multi EAN feature solves the issue of products with multiple EANs by allowing several codes for a single product. This is essential when the same item has different identifiers depending on the market or packaging. It’s not only a simplification for logistics and warehousing but also ensures correct product identification in sales systems. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Automatic Descriptions with Artificial Intelligence 
 
 With built-in AI, you can create product descriptions, technical specifications, or listing titles in seconds. The system analyses product data and generates professional, engaging content tailored to your industry, brand voice, and product specifics. You can focus on sales strategy while AI delivers high-quality content that attracts customers and drives conversions. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Professional Translations into Multiple Languages at Once 
 
 The integrated DeepL translator in Base lets you translate descriptions, attributes, tags, and other product data into dozens of languages with a single click—preserving industry context. It’s a huge time-saver for companies entering new markets and significantly reduces content localisation costs. With this feature, you can easily build a multilingual catalogue, improve SEO, and boost sales across multiple countries simultaneously. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Automatic Background Removal from Product Photos 
 
 Base automatically removes backgrounds from product photos, preparing them to meet the requirements of marketplaces like eBay and Amazon. There’s no need for a graphic designer or specialised tools—everything happens automatically. This feature improves the visual presentation of products and reduces the risk of listings being rejected due to incorrect image formatting. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Base.com is not just Product Manager
 
Base.com offers you complex sales management. In addition to the Product Manager, we also offer you access to a warehouse, where you can create a product database, a panel for bulk offer listing, and the ability to integrate your store with marketplace platforms.

no restrictions to the number of accounts connected even within the same marketplace or carrier

Marketplace Manager
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
list products from any warehouse (store, wholesaler, ERP or Base.com warehouse)
quick listing tools (including parameter auto-fill, offer templates, shipping templates and category links)
list product variants 
bulk operations on multiple offers at the same time
forward orders from marketplace to store and ERP
automatic stock synchronization between marketplace platforms and product warehouse
ability to automatically close out of stock offers
automatic offer price synchronization with prices in the main warehouse
ability to automatically close zero-price offers
Explore the other functions of the Marketplace Manager 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Order Manager
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
managing orders from marketplaces, stores, placed by phone or in person
fast order processing thanks to automatic actions
automatic forwarding of dropshipping orders (for wholesalers)
ability to forward orders to the store and ERP
Pick&Pack Assistant support (packing error warnings, taking photo of the shipment)
shipping packages (one by one, in bulk, automatically)
issuing invoices, proforma's, corrections and receipts as well as forwarding to online accounting systems
automatic email and SMS notifications to customers and a unique order information page
phone app displaying orders for the calling customer

Shipping management
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
instant access to multiple courier integrations
shipping packages (one by one, in bulk, automatically)
ordering a pick-up
forwarding tracking number to the marketplace and store
automatic printouts of the shipping labels and shipping manifest
customer updates on shipping number and package status
ability to create your own shipment size and weight templates
ability to monitor shipment statuses, delivery time, and each package's history
automatic verification of package delivery

Workflow automation
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
unlimited number of automatic actions, e.g. in status changes, issuing invoices, sending parcels, customer correspondence
Pick&Pack Assistant support - use a barcode scanner for product picking and parcel packing
fast printing of documents and shipping labels without the need to download files
trigger system actions with a keyboard shortcut, custom button or by scanning the barcode
information on the status of customer orders visible on the phone screen as soon as the caller's number is displayed (with Base Caller app)

Product warehouse
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
ability to create custom product database in the Base.com system (designed for retailers without a store)
ability to add an additional product catalogue from an online storefront (designed for store owners)
quick product listing to marketplaces directly from Base.com's warehouse
stock and price synchronization between warehouse and marketplace services
multiple ways to import products into warehouse: manually, by importing XML, or CSV files, or by creating products directly in the warehouse
ability to quickly export data using predefined templates or custom templates formats with selected content
Find out more about the capabilities of Base.com Warehouse

data security - backups created twice a day

employee profiles with separate logins and passwords

verification of actions performed by employees

employee efficiency tracking

Frequently Asked Questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I try the system before buying it?
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Before you decide to buy our services, you can test the program without any obligations for 14 days. The system is fully functional during the test period. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I change the subscription plan I am using?
 
 
 
 
 
 
 You can change your plan from Freemium to Business or from Business to Enterprise. Other plan changes are not possible. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I choose whether I am on the Business plan or the Enterprise plan?
 
 
 
 
 
 
Once you qualify for the Enterprise plan you will be contacted by our team, and to continue to use Base.com, you must switch to a dedicated Enterprise plan.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
When do I need to switch to the Enterprise plan?
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our Enterprise team will contact you when the scale of your business qualifies you for the Enterprise plan.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I use the Enterprise plan when my number of orders and GMV are lower than indicated in the Enterprise plan?
 
 
 
 
 
 
Yes. To do so, schedule a call with our enterprise team using 
this link
.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
If I have multiple Base.com accounts, do the volumes add up to determine if I qualify for the Enterprise plan?
 
 
 
 
 
 
Yes, in a situation where you manage your business using multiple accounts, we take into account the aggregated volumes from all accounts to qualify for the Enterprise plan.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Do you issue VAT invoices?
 
 
 
 
 
 
Yes, we issue VAT invoices. Subscription for using the system and payment details are described in the 
pricing section
.
